card.name: Inside author surnames in citations
card.fires_on: Partway through a foreign-looking surname of a researcher or author, often in a citation or reference, such as the piece before a hyphen or the middle of a double-barrelled name. Weaker hits appear on a few stray words like an opening bracket or the verb Eat.

modes.label: Surname pieces
modes.description: The middle of a long or hyphenated surname of a cited researcher.

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Occasional hits on a bracket or on a healthy-living verb at the start of advice.
modes.example: care of your body.<< Eat>> plenty of healthy foods

card.writes: It pushes toward the next piece of a name or code-like string and away from reflexive words such as yourself or himself.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unusual surnames of cited authors, such as in reference lists.
